Indeed there is a panic, a fear as the #HMPV rekindled the memories of #Covid_19 helpless days - can't be wiped out may do as much as propaganda. 

"Humein Marne ke liye Atmanirbhar banaya gaya tha" -  Poem Anurag Anant. https://t.co/lQV8VO
